@Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler isn't reachable from here: the automation tool returned a gateway credentials error, so no recurring job exists yet. Please ask whoever runs the OpenClaw gateway to fix its auth config, then ask me again and I'll set it up for Monday 19 October at 08:00 Chicago time.

When it's set up, the digest will be built from #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both channels have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so nothing will reach anyone who can't already see those channels. It will leave out money terms and finance documents such as contracts, order forms and invoices, since those go only to Anselm, June and the account owner. Operational items like seat counts, renewal dates, ticket numbers and meeting times will stay in.
